you emit the FINAL answer. You may take, correct, combine or discard any part of what they produced.
Where they disagree, decide, and say in your notes why. The final answer is yours and is what is scored.

0: Inputs, parsing and the five gate results -- Using the shared validate_generation output, write a concise prose section covering: (1) what was checked: generated design id ff-zf-chimera vs base zebrafish-adult, both repository design ids, n_edits 0, the desired-phenotype text parsed into 3 hard criteria (c1 glide_range_total_m >= 10 m from 1 m launch; c2 survives 18 C; c3 survives 28 C; all adult stage, with the stated assumptions, nothing unparsed or refused), and sequence basis document-only with loci_covered 0 and genome_fraction_assessed 0 (no sequence assessed). (2) The five named results side by side, each with its exact status and gate meaning: genotype_similarity cannot-assess; phenotype_similarity pass (inside calibrated shape distribution, body p 0.2649, shape similarity only, silent on features not read); lean_check cannot-assess (23 cannot-evaluate, 12 out of scope, no accepted-law violation found); functional_resolution cannot-assess (empty ledger is not evidence of no differences); physics_check cannot-assess. Do NOT sum, average, count or score the five results, and do not say 'X of 5 passed'. Do not mention the composite score. Assert nothing not in the output.
1: Physics check detail and what was not checked -- Using the shared validate_generation output, write a concise prose section focused on the physics_check and the criteria/gates that were not covered. Include: 1 of 3 hard criteria (glide/glide_range_total_m, the >=10 m glide from 1 m launch) has NO MODEL and was NOT checked, so the physics gate does not cover it; the standing check organ_volume_fits_body@adult failed, reported beside the gate and not folded into it: only 84.7 % of the requested flight-muscle volume fits inside the skin, the remaining 15.3 % has nowhere to go, so any power claim charging the full muscle mass is unphysical. Make clear the physics status is cannot-assess (not pass), yet the standing check failure is a real finding the collaborator needs to see. Also explain that genotype similarity cannot-assess is because the design has only morphological parameter deltas and no gene-level edit, so there is no allele to score, and that this is not a pass. Do not mention the composite score. Assert nothing not in the output.
2: Verdict, scale coverage and caveats -- Using the shared validate_generation output, write a concise prose section on the verdict and coverage. Include: the word 'validated' is WITHHELD (verdict.word_validated_withheld true), with withheld_because exactly: '4 gate(s) could not be assessed', '3 biological scale(s) could not be assessed', 'no sequence was compared at any locus'. State the verdict lists passed: phenotype_similarity; failed: none; could_not_assess: genotype_similarity, lean_check, functional_resolution, physics_check; and that the report is not a validity claim. From per_scale_coverage: scales NOT assessed are cell, tissue, organ_system (zero terms with a swept gene; organ_system has 3 terms but none with a molecular record, cell and tissue have 0 terms), so these are empty rather than clear; assessable scales are organ (7 terms, 3 with swept gene, 0.4286) and body (1 term, 1 with swept gene), plus the omics layers (sequence_genomic, transcriptomic, proteomic, ptm, pathway) each swept 9 genes of 9 in the sweep set while 3473 of 3481 genes annotated at the touched anatomy were not swept. Assert nothing not in the output.
